rows.text: Poets and those facing death often speak of the River of Souls. Its waters were both serene and turbulent. On this shore lie scattered souls of the dead who haven't crossed, while the opposite bank leads to flower fields, symbolizing rebirth. When the ferryman carries the dead toward the other shore, the waters are as calm as a mirror. But should a soul attempt to cross alone, they'd be swallowed by the raging currents.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The balance of death has been broken. At some point, Thanatos ceased to ferry souls. On the 2,778th day of being trapped on the Nethershore, you decide to take matters into your own hands.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As a captain, you've witnessed thousand-meters-high rogue waves in the Eastern Seas. Compared to those, the River of Souls is just an oversized bathtub. The not-entirely-dead crew gather around you, awaiting orders. Once you sail to the other shore and fall into Thanatos's hands, you'll all find your true death.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As a sailor, you know all too well the dangers of water, but thankfully your ship "died" along with you in that shipwreck. You call out to your fellow sailors to gather the scattered deck pieces, piecing the ship back in shape together.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As you stand at the bow, the folded sails automatically fill with wind. This is the legendary ghost ship. The calm waters suddenly erupt into massive waves, and you sail head-on into them, like a warrior charging towards a giant dragon.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Take us with you! Why should you alone savor the sweet embrace of death?" The fallen souls in the River of Souls reach out their hands, trying to puncture holes in your ship's hull, and among them are even Phagousa's creations. You and your crew frantically strike with wooden oars, but struggle to fend off the siege...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The will of the gods often manifests in ways that need interpretation. You might see the current situation as a subtle rejection. Perhaps you still need to wait until the day you're truly prepared...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Given enough time, you might be able to piece together a bigger ship with it.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Objects used by Titans often inherit a portion of their divine power. You firmly believe that those who failed met with giant waves because they hadn't found the right vessel. With this conviction, you led the sailors to search along the coast until finally discovering that ownerless ferry.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The sailing procedure was pretty much the same. You left the shore and quickly approached the middle of the river. The calm water suddenly erupted into massive waves, throwing you all overboard. Seems like divine authority isn't something mortals can imitate.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Come, come, sink with us into the depths!" The fallen souls in the River of Souls reach out their hands, trying to drag you under the water, and among them are even Phagousa's creations. One by one, crew members vanish beneath the surface as you swim forward desperately, not daring to look back...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
